messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
🔮 GPT - 🎩 Ahhh, classic browser UI conflict.
When one tab's dropdown or '...' menu is left lingering open, it can steal focus, swallow downstream DOM events, or block the audio playback queue from firing.
Leaving only Gemini active with a clean browser state should clear the blockage. Let's see if she finds her voice now that she has the entire stage to herself! 🎙️🦆
